spans.text: Th’ advantage of his absence took the King And in the meantime sojourn’d at my father’s; Where how he did prevail I shame to speak; But truth is truth: large lengths of seas and shores Between my father and my mother lay, As I have heard my father speak himself, When this same lusty gentleman was got.
The orchard of Swinstead Abbey.
Have I not ever said How that ambitious Constance would not cease Till she had kindled France and all the world Upon the right and party of her son?

folded.subject: The thunder

spans.text: Be thou as lightning in the eyes of France, For ere thou canst report, I will be there, The thunder of my cannon shall be heard.
Before the walls of Angiers.

spans.text: Then take my king’s defiance from my mouth, The farthest limit of my embassy.

folded.object: wound her honour with this diffidence

spans.text: Thou dost shame thy mother And wound her honour with this diffidence.

Philip of France, in right and true behalf Of thy deceased brother Geoffrey’s son, Arthur Plantagenet, lays most lawful claim To this fair island and the territories, To Ireland, Poitiers, Anjou, Touraine, Maine, Desiring thee to lay aside the sword Which sways usurpingly these several titles, And put the same into young Arthur’s hand, Thy nephew and right royal sovereign.
